div.div:
Orange: external participant. Navy: transformation. Green open-ended symbol: retained data. * repeats the same participant or record family; it is not a new system/store. Inactive candidates and
accepted evidence are distinct datasets in the same logical record family. Checkpoints, same-attempt resume, activation/rollback and stale delivery are sequences 29–31.
